notes: Observed maps are used only for Solar System bodies: Earth (this file) and the Moon, Mars and Jupiter (Solar/SOURCES.json). Every exoplanet and authored world keeps procedural, artistic surfaces. Earth clouds come from one frame of the NASA GEOS-5 atmospheric model (a model visualization, not observed or current weather).
Observed maps for the Moon, Mars and Jupiter, used only by the Solar System scene; Earth's maps are in Earth/SOURCES.json. Exoplanets and authored worlds keep procedural surfaces.

summary.en: Earth surface colour: NASA Blue Marble (cloud-free). Public domain.
summary.ru: Цвет поверхности Земли: NASA Blue Marble (без облаков). Общественное достояние.

images.content: NASA Blue Marble land surface and oceans, cloud-free composite
images.credit: NASA Visible Earth / NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (Blue Marble). Public domain.

summary.en: Earth city lights: NASA Black Marble 2012 (Suomi NPP). Public domain.
summary.ru: Огни городов Земли: NASA Black Marble 2012 (Suomi NPP). Общественное достояние.

images.content: Earth at night 2012 (Suomi NPP VIIRS day-night band composite, 'Black Marble')
images.credit: NASA Earth Observatory / NOAA NGDC, Suomi NPP. Public domain.

summary.en: Earth clouds: one frame of the NASA GEOS-5 atmospheric model (NASA SVS 3837). A model visualization, not observed weather.
summary.ru: Облака Земли: один кадр атмосферной модели NASA GEOS-5 (NASA SVS 3837). Модельная визуализация, не наблюдаемая погода.

images.content: Global cloud cover from the NASA GEOS-5 atmospheric model (14 km), one frame of SVS animation 3837
images.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio (GEOS-5). NASA media, no usage restrictions listed.

summary.en: Moon colour: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit from LRO LROC images. Public domain.
summary.ru: Цвет Луны: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit по снимкам LRO LROC. Общественное достояние.

images.content: LROC WAC colour mosaic with poles (CGI Moon Kit, 2019)
images.credit: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio, CGI Moon Kit (SVS 4720), data LRO LROC (NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University). Public domain (NASA).

summary.en: Moon relief shading: slopes computed from the NASA LRO LOLA elevation map (CGI Moon Kit); relief shown twice as strong for readability. Public domain.
summary.ru: Рельеф Луны: наклоны рассчитаны по карте высот NASA LRO LOLA (CGI Moon Kit); рельеф усилен вдвое для наглядности. Общественное достояние.

images.content: surface slopes from LOLA elevation: R = dh/d(east), G = dh/d(north), each clamp(slope*8, -1, 1)*0.5+0.5; B unused
images.credit: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit ldem_16_uint.tif (LRO LOLA). Public domain (NASA).

summary.en: Mars colour: USGS Viking MDIM2.1 mosaic (NASA/JPL/USGS). Public domain.
summary.ru: Цвет Марса: мозаика USGS Viking MDIM2.1 (NASA/JPL/USGS). Общественное достояние.

images.credit: NASA/JPL/USGS Astrogeology Science Center, Viking MDIM2.1. Public domain.

summary.en: Jupiter clouds: Cassini map PIA07782 from December 2000 (NASA/JPL/Space Science Institute). A snapshot, not today's Jupiter. Public domain.
summary.ru: Облака Юпитера: карта Cassini PIA07782, декабрь 2000 года (NASA/JPL/Space Science Institute). Снимок, а не сегодняшний Юпитер. Общественное достояние.
